facts.text: The UTRGV Tuition Advantage grant covers tuition and mandatory fees for students with a family income of $125,000 or less who have unmet financial need.

sources.title: UTRGV Tuition Advantage
sources.quote: The UTRGV Tuition Advantage grant covers the cost of tuition and mandatory fees for students with a family income of $125,000 or less who have unmet financial need.
